# The one-time NSFW model export (api/tools/export_nsfw_model.py, contract milestone-4 §4.1). Never installed in
# any image: run it in a throwaway container, e.g. from the repo root
#
#   docker run --rm -v "$PWD/api:/api" -w /api \
#     python:3.14-slim@sha256:22eafb370920ad8b429e0aec3fff433e0669968519f5d60469d83729c138b28b \
#     sh -c 'pip install --require-hashes --no-deps --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu \
#            --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple -r tools/export-requirements.txt \
#            && python -m tools.export_nsfw_model'
#
# Resolved 2026-11-25 on Python 3.14 (the newest Python every pin below has wheels for), every transitive
# dependency included, with the hash of every published file of each version.
# torch and torchvision come from PyTorch's CPU-only index: the PyPI torch 2.15.0 wheels for Linux pull in the
# CUDA 13 toolkit (several GB), which an export on CPU never uses. torchvision is held at 0.29.1+cpu, the newest
# CPU build for cp314 on that index (PyPI has 0.29.2); timm 1.0.31 needs it.
